## What's New in Quote 2.1.2

* Restoring a damaged or tampered backup file no longer crashes the app
* A widget added on a new phone no longer takes over the style of a widget from the old phone
* Hearts tapped while community quotes sync are no longer lost
* Author portraits and bios no longer disappear for a month after a temporary Wikipedia error
* If the quote library cannot be updated once, Quote tries again on the next start
* Safeguard for future updates: a database change can no longer wipe your own quotes and favorites
